Trigger / Detection Logic: SUM(debits) <> SUM(credits) OR TB total <> 0
Expected State (industry norm): TB balances to nil
Query to Client: The trial balance provided does not balance (difference £[x]). Please provide a balanced TB or explain the difference.
Evidence Required: Balanced TB export from the ledger
Engineer Notes: Block all downstream engines until resolved.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Opening balance per GL/TB <> closing balance per prior-year signed accounts (by line)
Expected State (industry norm): Opening reserves and balances agree to prior-year filed accounts
Query to Client: Opening balances do not agree to the prior-year financial statements for [accounts]. Please explain differences or confirm any prior-year adjustments were posted.
Evidence Required: Prior-year signed accounts, final adjusting journals
Engineer Notes: Prior-period error vs late posting must be judged by human (FRS 102 s10 restatement).

Trigger / Detection Logic: Balance <> 0 on accounts matching suspense|clearing|unallocated|undeposited|ask accountant|misc
Expected State (industry norm): Suspense and clearing accounts are nil at year end
Query to Client: A balance of £[x] remains in [suspense/clearing account] at year end. Please provide an analysis of the items making up this balance.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Debtor-type account with credit balance OR creditor-type with debit balance OR asset cost negative OR accumulated depreciation debit
Expected State (industry norm): Accounts carry their natural balance
Query to Client: [Account] carries an unusual [debit/credit] balance of £[x]. Please explain (e.g. overpayment, misposting, unallocated receipt).
Engineer Notes: Reclassify credit debtors to creditors (and vice versa) if material — no offset unless legal right (s11/IAS 32).

Trigger / Detection Logic: Account names do not map to the CoA keyword library (see CoA_Map) OR mapped to wrong FS line
Expected State (industry norm): Every nominal maps to one FS caption
Query to Client: We could not identify the nature of [account]. Please describe what is posted to this account.
Engineer Notes: Auto-resolve allowed when keyword confidence >= threshold set in Analytics_Tests.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Bank nominal balance <> bank statement closing balance at YE
Expected State (industry norm): Bank reconciled with only timing items
Query to Client: Please provide year-end bank statements and bank reconciliations for all accounts (including savings, card, PayPal/Stripe and foreign currency accounts).
Evidence Required: YE bank statements, reconciliation, list of unpresented items

Trigger / Detection Logic: Unpresented items on YE rec older than 60 days OR not cleared in post-YE statement
Expected State (industry norm): Reconciling items clear shortly after YE
Query to Client: The following reconciling items had not cleared by [date]. Please explain each item.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Bank account referenced in GL descriptions / transfers (e.g. 'transfer to savings') with no matching nominal
Expected State (industry norm): All bank accounts in the company's name are recorded
Query to Client: Transfers to/from an account not in the ledger were identified. Please confirm all bank, savings, card and payment-platform accounts held by the company.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Cash-in-hand balance large vs monthly takings OR negative at any month end
Expected State (industry norm): Cash balance positive and supported by count
Query to Client: Cash in hand shows £[x] (negative at [month]). Please provide the year-end cash count and explain negative balances.
Engineer Notes: Negative cash usually indicates unrecorded receipts or expenses paid personally (DLA).

Trigger / Detection Logic: Turnover per TB vs VAT returns box 6 for the period (adjusted for exempt/zero/outside scope & timing) variance > tolerance
Expected State (industry norm): Accounts turnover reconciles to VAT returns
Query to Client: Turnover per the accounts (£[x]) differs from net sales declared on VAT returns (£[y]). Please provide a reconciliation.
Evidence Required: VAT returns for all periods overlapping the year

Trigger / Detection Logic: Sales invoices dated within 30 days after YE with service/delivery dates before YE (or vice versa)
Expected State (industry norm): Revenue recognised in the period performance occurs
Query to Client: Invoices raised after year end appear to relate to work/goods delivered before year end. Please confirm delivery/performance dates.
Evidence Required: Post-YE sales invoices, delivery notes, timesheets

Trigger / Detection Logic: Monthly revenue deviates > X% from rolling 3-month mean with no seasonal pattern flagged for industry
Expected State (industry norm): Revenue pattern consistent with business model
Query to Client: Revenue in [month] was [x]% above/below the trend. Please explain (new contract, loss of customer, posting error).

Trigger / Detection Logic: Trade debtors control <> aged debtors listing total
Expected State (industry norm): Control account agrees to sales ledger
Query to Client: Please provide the aged debtors report at year end reconciled to the trade debtors balance.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Debtors > 90 days OR not received within 60 days post-YE
Expected State (industry norm): Old balances assessed for recoverability
Query to Client: The following balances are over 90 days old / unpaid after year end. Please confirm recoverability and any disputes.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: CTA 2009 s55 / specific bad debt relief; VAT Notice 700/18 (bad debt relief after 6 months)
Engineer Notes: Tax deduction for impairment follows GAAP for loan relationships/trade debts; VAT bad debt relief separate — flag both.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Annual invoices (insurance, software, rates, subscriptions, rent in advance) posted in last 6 months AND prepayments balance = 0 or unchanged
Expected State (industry norm): Prepayments recognised for unexpired periods
Query to Client: Annual costs (e.g. [supplier], £[x]) were paid during the year. Please confirm the period covered so the unexpired portion can be prepaid.
Engineer Notes: Auto-calc allowed where invoice period parsed from description; human review if > materiality.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Recurring supplier with invoice for final month(s) missing (see Analytics A-REC-01) OR accruals balance nil
Expected State (industry norm): Costs incurred but not invoiced at YE are accrued
Query to Client: No invoice was recorded for [supplier] for [month(s)]. Please confirm whether costs were incurred and provide post-YE invoices.

Trigger / Detection Logic: No accountancy/audit fee accrual at YE
Expected State (industry norm): Accrual for accounts preparation fee
Query to Client: Please confirm the agreed fee for this year's accounts so an accrual can be included.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Trade creditors control <> aged creditors listing OR supplier statements differ
Expected State (industry norm): Control account agrees to purchase ledger
Query to Client: Please provide the aged creditors report and statements for the main suppliers at year end.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Payments in first 60 days post-YE relating to pre-YE goods/services not in creditors/accruals
Expected State (industry norm): All liabilities at YE recorded
Query to Client: Payments after year end to [supplier] appear to relate to the prior period. Please confirm and provide invoices.

Trigger / Detection Logic: VAT control balance <> last VAT return liability + post-return quarter activity
Expected State (industry norm): VAT liability agrees to returns
Query to Client: The VAT liability in the TB (£[x]) does not agree to the VAT return for the period ending [date]. Please provide all VAT returns and the VAT control reconciliation.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: VATA 1994; MTD for VAT; Notice 700/45 error correction

Trigger / Detection Logic: Not VAT registered AND rolling 12-month taxable turnover > P-VAT-REG at any month end OR forward 30-day test
Expected State (industry norm): Registered when threshold breached
Query to Client: Taxable turnover appears to have exceeded the VAT registration threshold in [month]. Please confirm VAT registration status and effective date.
Engineer Notes: Run rolling 12-month test monthly, not just on annual turnover.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Input VAT claimed on: business entertainment, car purchase, personal items, insurance, exempt supplies, no VAT invoice
Expected State (industry norm): Input tax only on business supplies with valid evidence
Query to Client: Input VAT appears to have been claimed on [items] which may be blocked or non-business. Please confirm the business purpose / provide VAT invoices.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Scheme flagged (Flat Rate / Cash / Annual) – test eligibility vs P-VAT-FRS, P-VAT-CASH-JOIN/LEAVE; FRS limited-cost-trader test
Expected State (industry norm): Scheme used is eligible and appropriate
Query to Client: Please confirm the VAT scheme(s) used during the year. Based on turnover/costs, the eligibility or suitability of the [scheme] should be reviewed.
Engineer Notes: Recommendation to assess only — never conclude a scheme is 'preferable' automatically.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Gross wages per GL <> P32/RTI FPS totals for the tax months in the period; PAYE control <> amount due to HMRC
Expected State (industry norm): Payroll costs agree to RTI submissions
Query to Client: Please provide the payroll summary (P32 / FPS totals) for the year and reconcile to wages and the PAYE/NIC creditor.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Employees on payroll AND no pension cost / pension creditor
Expected State (industry norm): Auto-enrolment contributions where staff eligible
Query to Client: Employees are on payroll but no workplace pension costs were identified. Please confirm the auto-enrolment position and provider.
Evidence Required: Pension provider statements, declaration of compliance

Trigger / Detection Logic: EA claimed AND (single-director-only payroll OR connected-company claim)
Expected State (industry norm): EA claimed only where eligible
Query to Client: Employment Allowance appears to have been claimed. Please confirm eligibility (e.g. not a company where the director is the only employee paid above the secondary threshold).

Trigger / Detection Logic: Expenses for private medical, company car, van, accommodation, personal costs paid by company
Expected State (industry norm): Benefits reported on P11D or payrolled
Query to Client: Costs that may be employee benefits were identified ([list]). Please confirm whether P11D / payrolling of benefits applies.

Trigger / Detection Logic: FA cost/NBV per TB <> fixed asset register
Expected State (industry norm): TB agrees to FAR
Query to Client: Please provide the fixed asset register reconciled to the TB, with additions and disposals in the year.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Single expense lines (repairs, IT, equipment, motor) > capitalisation threshold (P-CAP-THR)
Expected State (industry norm): Capital items capitalised per policy
Query to Client: The following items expensed exceed the capitalisation threshold. Please confirm whether they are repairs or new/improved assets.
Engineer Notes: Tax engine runs capital allowance pools separately from accounting capitalisation.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Receipts described 'sale of vehicle/equipment' OR asset removed from FAR without disposal journal
Expected State (industry norm): Disposals recorded with profit/loss
Query to Client: A disposal of [asset] appears to have occurred. Please confirm proceeds, date and whether VAT was charged.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Depreciation charge / opening cost outside expected % range per policy OR nil with assets present
Expected State (industry norm): Depreciation consistent with policy
Query to Client: Depreciation appears [not charged / inconsistent with policy]. Please confirm depreciation policies.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Recurring payments to lessors / HP / 'lease' / 'rent' / vehicle finance with no lease liability or HP creditor
Expected State (industry norm): Lease/HP obligations recognised per framework
Query to Client: Recurring lease/finance payments to [lessor] identified. Please provide the agreements (start date, term, payments, options).
FRS 102 Ref: 20 Leases (periods ≥1 Jan 2026: lessee on-balance-sheet, short-term & low-value exemptions)
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: Lease tax rules (CTA 2010 Part 21A long funding); VAT 50% block on car leases
Engineer Notes: Framework switch: period start date decides old (operating/finance) vs new FRS 102 s20 model.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Loan balance <> lender statement OR no split current/non-current OR interest nil with loan present
Expected State (industry norm): Loans agree to statements, split by maturity, interest accrued
Query to Client: Please provide year-end loan statements and agreements (including Bounce Back/CBILS, director and related-party loans).

Trigger / Detection Logic: DLA overdrawn at YE (debit) OR overdrawn at any point
Expected State (industry norm): DLA in credit or repaid within 9 months; s455 assessed
Query to Client: The director's loan account is overdrawn by £[x] at year end. Please confirm repayments after year end (dates and amounts) and any amounts to be cleared by dividend or salary.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: CTA 2010 s455 (P-S455) / s458 relief / s464C 30-day & arrangements rules; ITEPA s175 beneficial loans (P-BIK-LOAN)
Engineer Notes: s455 rate depends on date loan made (see Parameters).

Trigger / Detection Logic: Payees/descriptions match personal keywords (supermarket, Amazon personal, school fees, holiday, gym, Netflix)
Expected State (industry norm): Personal costs charged to DLA, not P&L
Query to Client: The following costs appear personal in nature. Please confirm business purpose or whether they should be charged to the director's loan account.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Dividends declared > distributable reserves (opening P&L reserve + current profit after tax) OR dividends without vouchers/minutes
Expected State (industry norm): Dividends lawful and documented
Query to Client: Dividends of £[x] exceed estimated distributable reserves. Please provide board minutes and dividend vouchers, and confirm dates paid.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: Companies Act 2006 s830-s836 (unlawful distributions); dividend tax (P-DIV)

Trigger / Detection Logic: Share capital per TB <> Companies House statement of capital
Expected State (industry norm): Share capital agrees to public record
Query to Client: Share capital in the TB does not agree to Companies House. Please confirm any share issues/buybacks in the year.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Counterparty names match director names / connected companies list / intercompany accounts
Expected State (industry norm): Related-party transactions identified and disclosed
Query to Client: Transactions with [party] were identified. Please confirm the relationship, nature and terms of these transactions.

Trigger / Detection Logic: CT creditor <> prior-year CT600 liability less payments + current charge
Expected State (industry norm): CT creditor reconciles to returns & payments
Query to Client: Please provide the prior-year CT600 / computation and evidence of CT payments made in the year.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: CTA 2009/2010; rates P-CT-*; late filing penalties increased from 1 Apr 2026

Trigger / Detection Logic: Expenses in: entertainment, fines/penalties, donations, depreciation, client gifts > limit, legal on capital items
Expected State (industry norm): Disallowable items identified for add-back
Query to Client: Please confirm the nature of [items] so the correct tax treatment can be applied.
Engineer Notes: Tax engine only; no accounting adjustment.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Framework FRS 102 AND (capital allowances ≠ depreciation OR losses OR revaluations) AND no deferred tax balance
Expected State (industry norm): Deferred tax on timing differences (FRS 102); none under FRS 105
Query to Client: No deferred tax has been recognised. We will assess timing differences — please confirm any tax losses brought forward.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Net liabilities OR net current liabilities OR loss-making 2 years OR overdue HMRC liabilities
Expected State (industry norm): Going concern basis supportable
Query to Client: The company has [net liabilities/losses]. Please provide your assessment of going concern for at least 12 months from approval, including support from directors/lenders.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Large post-YE receipts/payments, legal costs, customer insolvency, asset impairments after YE
Expected State (industry norm): Adjusting / non-adjusting events identified
Query to Client: Please confirm any significant events since year end (claims, loss of customers, new borrowing, disposals).

Trigger / Detection Logic: Legal/professional fees with 'claim', 'dispute', 'tribunal', 'settlement' descriptions
Expected State (industry norm): Obligations provided or disclosed
Query to Client: Legal costs relating to [matter] were identified. Please explain the matter and likely outcome.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Manual journals > materiality OR posted after YE dated before YE OR round-sum OR posted by unusual user
Expected State (industry norm): Journals supported and authorised
Query to Client: Please provide support for the following manual journals.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Foreign currency bank/debtor/creditor balances present
Expected State (industry norm): Monetary items retranslated at closing rate
Query to Client: Foreign currency balances were identified. Please confirm currency and amounts so year-end retranslation can be applied.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Receipts from government bodies / 'grant' / Innovate UK / council
Expected State (industry norm): Grant recognised per conditions
Query to Client: Grant receipts identified. Please provide the grant agreements and conditions.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Receipts from insurers OR 'claim' in descriptions
Expected State (industry norm): Reimbursement recognised when virtually certain
Query to Client: Insurance receipts/claims identified. Please confirm the claim details and status at year end.

Trigger / Detection Logic: Size test using P-SIZE-* thresholds for 2 consecutive years
Expected State (industry norm): Correct size regime & filing format applied
Query to Client: Based on turnover/balance sheet/employees the company appears to be [micro/small/medium]. Please confirm average employee numbers.
Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: CA 2006 s382-s384B, s465; Companies House changes from Apr 2028 (P&L filing, no abridged)
